1.explanation: There are two pieces to this regression: 1) In src/ol/style/Image.js (the base ImageStyle class) the setOpacity method merely updates an internal property opacity_ but does not dispatch any change event to notify renderers. In prior versions style changes implicitly forced a redraw. 2) In src/ol/renderer/canvas/VectorLayer.js the renderer only listens for image‐loading events (via handleStyleImageChange_) but never for style property changes. Because ImageStyle.setOpacity doesn’t emit an event, the VectorLayerRenderer never knows it needs to clear and re-render and the new opacity value is never applied to the canvas builder.
1.bug_scenario: In OpenLayers 6.2.0 the setOpacity call on an image‐based style no longer causes any visible change to the rendered features. In 6.1.1 repeatedly calling setOpacity (for example to animate a blinking effect) worked – you could see the icon fade in and out – but as soon as you upgrade to 6.2.0 nothing changes on screen when you call setOpacity. The JSFiddle examples in the report demonstrate that in 6.1.1 the icon blinks, but in 6.2.0 it stays at constant opacity.
